DSpine parallel drafter (arXiv 2609.36173) for Qwen3-8B safetensors checkpoints; sglang lane only - serve with spec = "dspine" on a lane carrying the DSpine algorithm (native upstream or the sglang-dspine plugin lane). Capacity boundary: the drafter reads the target lm_head and needs it unquantized bf16 (--dtype bfloat16; quantized targets must exclude "lm_head" in quantization_config.modules_to_not_convert), and full-capacity dspine (no CPU offload) needs a bf16/fp8-native target or a >=12 GiB card - as of 2026-11-09 no quantized-safetensors Qwen3-8B variant ships a bf16 lm_head, and community 4B drafts are dated training-run checkpoints, not stable pairs.
